title: Air India Delhi-Amritsar flight entered Pakistan airspace on Monday night, causing delay to passengers
summary: Air India Delhi-Amritsar flight entered Pakistan airspace on Monday night, causing delay to passengers The Tribune
title_hi: तकनीकी खराबी से भटका विमान , पाकिस्तान की सीमा में पहुंचा ; चार घंटे बाद अमृतसर पहुंचे 150 यात्री - air india flight entered pakistan due technical fault returned safely delhi amritsar
